brief:
Israeli forces opened fire on two Palestinians in southern Gaza on Saturday evening, the Shehab Wire reported. The shooting took place in an area southeast of Gaza City, though initial reports provided limited detail on what prompted the military operation or the extent of the casualties.

The incident marked a continuation of armed confrontations in the territory. Israeli military operations in Gaza have resulted in regular civilian casualties, with shooting incidents occurring across multiple locations in the enclave.
